exact_source_v1_acceptance.scope: Three source manifests and two exact original JPEGs only; no native text, stage, ancestry, FIDES reading transfer or whole-book claim. Current derivative changes source notes only to record this actual acceptance; its per-input provenance adds no source acquisition.

imprint_lines_directly_read: Et GABRIELIS CRAMOISY, viâ Iacobæâ, sub Ciconijs.

prayer_page.relevant_locus: Perceptio prayer, left column; entire original page retained. No reading is transferred to a concealed FIDES region.

identity.evidence_ceiling: The original PP7 image directly verifies the title, Paris Cramoisy imprint, Primo Editum and M. DC. LVII date. The inspected body page has different pagination and typesetting from FIDES 3755 printed 215. Their bibliographic/body relationship is unresolved. This source-library separation is an observed-setting distinction, not a claim of a new historical recension, format, impression, inherited reading, or exact FIDES setting.

acquisition_facts.method: Direct curl acquisition of complete publicly offered original-page responses; images then hashed and directly viewed locally. No OCR or model reconstruction supplied source wording.

actual_delivery_route.unsigned_route_claim: No unsigned image endpoint is claimed to have delivered the historical source JPEGs.

selected_payloads.role: Complete original title and imprint page; no printed folio claimed.
Complete original Canon Missæ. page, printed folio 293, at Google locator PA215; includes the Perceptio prayer in the left column. Google PA215 is a provider locator, not the printed page number.

acquisition_facts.acquisition_bound: Two necessary complete original pages only. No whole book, PDF, OCR corpus, modern replacement edition or new FIDES native page was acquired. The original search follow-up stopped after the recorded bounded checks; no new acquisition occurred while preparing this proposal.
acquisition_facts.modern_marks: Both complete JPEGs preserve their intact Digitized by Google stamps; no other modern addition was observed on direct visual review.

rights_assessment.status: The exact source identity, provenance and bounded U.S. rights assessment are independently accepted by the pinned source-V1 acceptance receipt. This public bookkeeping derivative preserves the accepted historical scope and exact image bytes.
rights_assessment.basis: United States: the observed title/imprint dates this historical printed source to 1657, beyond the U.S. publication term. This exact artifact is a faithful flat reproduction of an old printed page surface, with no independently original modern photographic composition or modern editorial/translated text observed. The artifact-specific copying/originality assessment follows U.S. Copyright Office Compendium 313.4(A) and 909.3(A), using the existing retained primary evidence; that administrative guidance is not a source-owner licence or a court holding about these bytes. The unchanged Digitized by Google stamp remains intact and is treated under src/sources/inventories/google-usage-guidelines-rights-v1.toml for attribution only, outside Triptych's CC BY 4.0 grant. The independent historical-work and flat-copy basis controls; the stamp rule does not settle direct-download terms. No general Google licence, complete applicable-contract determination, or other-jurisdiction clearance is asserted.

existing_primary_evidence.locus: 909.3(A), chapter page 22, existing complete retained text derivative

existing_stamp_record.limit: Attribution/stamp rule only; its unresolved adjacent direct-download terms question is not converted into permission. No stamp-only licence basis.

rights_assessment.limits: No general Google licence or other-jurisdiction clearance; no external-cover photograph exception; no modern wrapper clearance. Existing primary evidence is reused by exact ID without reacquisition. Rights assessment does not establish source-setting identity or permit a FIDES reading transfer.

searches.result_bound: Initial aliases surfaced the Google/Lyon and known FIDES deliveries, secondary historical accounts, and a 1669 RPB catalogue candidate. Secondary accounts were not used for prayer wording.
Google ID a8329mzqJMUC was the promising new exact-title/year lead; known FIDES edition 3755 also surfaced. No additional exact original copy was identified in the returned result set.
The same Google/Lyon delivery surfaced. No separate Lyon-hosted original image delivery or BnF original scan was identified in this result set.
No additional matching-setting original image was identified. Numerical mentions in secondary pages were not accepted as edition or page evidence.

Known FIDES 3755 was returned. Other returned BnF/CCFr records were unrelated manuscript or collection records. No further exact original setting was identified in the returned result set. These are search-engine bounds, not exhaustive direct catalogue searches or a world-wide absence claim.

candidate_facts.disposition: Promising exact-title/year lead verified at original title/imprint PP7, but inspected body page has a different observed setting; two complete original images proposed as a distinct source witness.
Different date/edition; declined. No original book or page payload acquired; catalogue facts are not prayer evidence.
Already known native delivery and download alias; no independent new scan or repair-free delivery established and no duplicate native source page fetched.

failed_api_event.evidence_limit: Status only. No volume JSON body exists in this acquisition and no affirmative platform rights licence or flag was inferred.

remaining_gaps.reason: A triangular physical repair conceals source sorts on baselines 17–18 and the prefix before visible medélam per- on baseline 19. The distinct Google setting does not expose these exact FIDES sorts. No reconstruction or reading transfer is accepted.
Any punctuation following visible ætérnam, Amen is concealed by the right-side repair. No final period is inferred from another witness.

bounded_negative: Within the recorded query sets and the directly acquired Google/Lyon, FIDES, and RPB metadata/pages, no independent original image of the exact FIDES large-type p.215 setting was established. This does not assert that no other copy, scan, or matching setting exists.
